get.description: Issues (or rotates) the readable CSRF cookie for web clients. Call it on app load before any cookie-authenticated request (e.g. /auth/refresh): read the csrf_token cookie and echo its value in the X-CSRF-Token header. Harmless for mobile clients, which ignore it. Returns 204.

post.description: Entry point for first launch: creates an anonymous user and returns an access/refresh token pair so the device can call authenticated endpoints. Pass the optional Idempotency-Key header to make retries safe.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional high-entropy key (24-128 chars, base64url/hex/UUID) to safely retry guest creation without creating duplicate users. High entropy is required because guest requests share an anonymous namespace.

post.description: Exchanges a valid refresh token for a fresh token pair and invalidates the old one (rotation). Mobile clients send the token in the body; web clients (X-Client-Type: web) send it via the refresh cookie plus the X-CSRF-Token header, and receive the rotated token as a cookie. Replaying a consumed refresh token triggers reuse detection; pass the optional Idempotency-Key header to retry a dropped response safely.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional opaque key (16-128 chars, no whitespace) to safely retry this refresh without triggering reuse detection.
